review.why: Keeps secrets out of n8n workflows: use credentials, bind existing ones by ID, and handle a token pasted in chat as leaked.
review.summary: Three rules: secrets go through the credential system, list credentials then bind by ID, and credential creation is the user's job. It gives a decision tree for authentication, what to do when a user pastes a secret (do not use it, bind or ask for a credential, tell them to rotate it) and an anti-pattern table. Four references cover the system and custom auth.
strengths: Tells the agent to treat any pasted secret as compromised
Always names the exact credential type for the user to create
Warns about the silent wrong binding when several credentials match
cautions: Specific to n8n and its tools
Four reference files are not read here
Cannot create credentials itself, by design
